alternatives.option: the scope slice, and to delete resolved obligations before scoring rather than hiding them at render

constraints: Fix only defects confirmed by 2/2 adversarial verifiers with low fix risk
No breaking changes to tool response shapes
context: Fixed 6 confirmed high-severity defects: assemble ordering, resolved-obligation leak, silent warning drop, why() retired statuses, ingest data loss, reverse-migrate wipe
rationale: the resolving entry is frequently posted against a different scope, and filtering at render would leave resolved items consuming budget that live ones need
summary: Chose to compute resolved ids from the full live board rather than the scope slice, and to delete resolved obligations before scoring rather than hiding them at render
